data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024 Türkiye note summarizes results from the OECD Teaching and Learning International Survey, focusing on lower secondary teachers and principals’ self-reports collected in 2024. The report is descriptive and comparative: it highlights statistically significant differences or changes relative to the OECD average and provides percentages for teacher background, teaching for today’s world, student diversity, special education needs, social and emotional skills, technology use (including AI), teachers’ learning opportunities (initial teacher education, induction/mentoring, continuous professional learning), teacher leadership and autonomy, professional relationships, status of the teaching profession, terms of employment, demands of teaching, and professional outcomes/well-being. The note does not estimate predictive models or report ML performance metrics; it also does not document PV handling or missing-data procedures at the note level. Interpretation should consider that TALIS relies on self-reports and that cross-country comparisons may be affected by social and cultural context, as explicitly cautioned in the note.
